# Déloci

Déloci is a mobile-first PWA for personal safety and trusted check-ins. It helps users set countdown timers for walks or commutes, share live GPS location with trusted contacts, and escalate alerts when a journey is overdue.

## Core capabilities
- Safe check-in countdowns for departures and arrivals
- Live GPS sharing for ongoing sessions
- Trusted contact dispatches for missed or overdue sessions
- Emergency-circle alert flow for real-time safety visibility

## Product focus
Déloci is designed for deloci.online as a consent-first safety app that keeps the user in control of when check-ins begin, who receives alerts, and when escalation is triggered.
